findings.evidence: InvariantMass.lean:170-173 (current proof); the needed factorisation is the PR's own `minkowskiProduct_self_eq_mul_of_spatialPart_eq_smul` in MinkowskiProductExtensions.lean, and the cone bound is `abs_sub_lt_add` (InvariantMass.lean:104).
findings.fix: Add `sqrt_minkowskiProduct_self_pos_of_spatialPart_eq_smul (hn : ‖n‖ = 1) (hv : v.spatialPart = a • n) (h : |a| < v.timeComponent) : 0 < √⟪v, v⟫ₘ` in MinkowskiProductExtensions.lean (two lines: `minkowskiProduct_self_eq_mul_of_spatialPart_eq_smul` + `Real.sqrt_pos`, both factors positive), and obtain the photon–target case from `components_add_target` + `abs_sub_lt_add`.
findings.issue: `sqrt_minkowskiProduct_add_self_pos` proves `0 < √⟪v,v⟫ₘ` only for the real-photon-plus-target configuration (`hn hq hq' hP hP' hk hp hpE`), via a detour through `exp_rapidity_mul_targetEnergy_add_momentum`. The fact is general: for any `v` with `v.spatialPart = a • n`, `‖n‖ = 1` and `|a| < v.timeComponent`, `⟪v,v⟫ₘ = (v⁰+a)(v⁰-a) > 0`.

findings.evidence: Proofs at InvariantMass.lean:129-131, 140-145, 170-173 go only through `components_add_target` (lines 95-99), which uses `hq`/`hq'` solely to compute `(q+P).timeComponent = k + E` and `(q+P).spatialPart = (k - p) • n`; the generic Rapidity.lean lemmas already hold for arbitrary components.
findings.fix: Make the axial momentum an independent variable, `hq' : q.spatialPart = a • n` with cone hypothesis `|a - p| < k + E`, in `components_add_target`, `exp_two_mul_rapidity_of_realPhoton` (→ `(k + a + E - p)/(k - a + E + p)`), `two_mul_photonEnergy_add_targetEnergy_sub_momentum_eq_sqrt_mul_exp_rapidity` (→ `k + a + E - p = W e^{y}`), the positivity lemma and `exp_two_mul_rapidity_of_realPhoton_energyFraction`; derive the present statements at `a = k`. `targetEnergy_add_momentum_eq_sqrt_mul_exp_neg_rapidity` and `two_mul_photonEnergy_eq_exp_rapidity_mul_sub_div_sqrt` do need nullness in their shape and can stay as the `a = k` corollaries.
findings.issue: The `RealPhoton` section ties the axial momentum to the energy (`hq : q.timeComponent = k`, `hq' : q.spatialPart = k • n`, i.e. `⟪q,q⟫ₘ = 0`), but the rapidity results only use the light-cone components of `q + P`, so nullness is stronger than their proofs need. This matters here: §0.1's own `ChargedSource.not_isReal_of_mem_photonRegion` (Kinematics/Basic.lean:329) proves a massive source never emits a photon with `Q² = 0`, so the only exported rapidity statements apply to a configuration the companion file rules out, even though the invariant-mass lemma `minkowskiProduct_add_self_of_target` keeps `q²` explicit.

findings.evidence: grep for `cosh_rapidity|sinh_rapidity` over ./code returns hits only inside Rapidity.lean itself (definitions, docstring lines 28-37, and the derivations at 149/159/191/200); InvariantMass.lean uses only `..._mul_exp_rapidity_of_spatialPart_eq_smul` and `..._mul_exp_neg_rapidity_of_spatialPart_eq_smul`.
findings.fix: Drop the two `_of_spatialPart_eq_smul` cosh/sinh lemmas and keep the generic cosh/sinh statements; the collinear exp forms (165, 176), which InvariantMass.lean does use, stay.
findings.issue: `timeComponent_eq_sqrt_minkowskiProduct_mul_cosh_rapidity_of_spatialPart_eq_smul` (185) and `eq_sqrt_minkowskiProduct_mul_sinh_rapidity_of_spatialPart_eq_smul` (195) are one-rewrite specialisations of the generic `timeComponent_eq_sqrt_mul_cosh_rapidity` (145) / `inner_spatialPart_eq_sqrt_mul_sinh_rapidity` (154) under `minkowskiProduct_self_eq_sq_sub_inner_sq_of_spatialPart_eq_smul`; neither is used anywhere, and §0.1 needs only the `exp` forms.

summary: The general-before-special discipline is mostly respected (massless and energy-fraction forms are derived, not reproved), but three statements sit at the wrong level: positivity of W is proved only for the photon–target pair although it is a property of any collinear vector in the forward cone, the rapidity lemmas assume an exactly null photon where only the light-cone components matter, and two collinear cosh/sinh lemmas are unused restatements of the generic ones.
